verdict.rationale: Mastra's own workflow engine claims built-in step retries as part of composing production workflows, so the core capability is first-party. The evidence is a single marketing line and gives no detail on how retries are configured. Missing for 10: configurable backoff strategies, per-step timeouts, failure/error policies (e.g. fallback or abort semantics), confirmation that retries remove try/catch scaffolding, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, every step retries automatically with configurable backoff, timeouts, and failure policies — no try/catch scaffolding

citations.quote: Compose typed steps, retries, and branches into production workflows your team can inspect and ship.
